epic.title: In-App Messaging & Trade Chat
epic.description: Add real-time channel-based chat so users can discuss trades and market ideas without leaving the xCube app. Includes live ticker card sharing, content moderation, and MiFID II-compliant message retention.

features.title: Channel Management
features.description: Users can create, join, and leave topic-based trading channels with persistent membership.

stories.title: Browse and join a public channel
stories.i_want: find and join a channel dedicated to a stock I'm watching
stories.so_that: I can follow live discussions about that ticker without leaving xCube
acceptance_criteria: Given I open the Chat tab, When the channel list loads, Then I see public channels sorted by recent activity, each showing: name, topic, and member count
Given I tap a channel I haven't joined, When I tap 'Join', Then I am added as a member and the channel thread is displayed immediately
Given I am already a member of a channel, When I open the Chat tab, Then my joined channels appear at the top of the list with an unread badge if there are new messages
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: POST /api/channels/:id/join is idempotent and returns 200 if already a member
Backend: GET /api/channels returns channels sorted by last_message_at DESC with member_count
Web: ChannelListScreen renders unread badges using last_read_at comparison
iOS: Join action updates local cache and shows channel immediately without refresh
Android: Channel list uses RecyclerView with DiffUtil for efficient updates
stories.technical_notes: Requires real-time subscription to channel_updates for live member count

then: Channel list displays all public channels

Channels are sorted by recent activity

given: User sees a channel they are not a member of
then: User is added as a member

then: Joined channels appear at the top

stories.title: Create a new public channel
stories.i_want: create a topic channel for a ticker or theme that doesn't exist yet
stories.so_that: I can seed a community around a stock or strategy I follow
acceptance_criteria: Given I tap 'New Channel', When I enter a name and topic and tap 'Create', Then the channel is created, I am auto-joined as the founder, and the channel appears in the list immediately
Given I enter a channel name that already exists, When I tap 'Create', Then an inline error 'A channel with this name already exists' is shown and no duplicate is created
Given I enter a channel name containing a blocked keyword, When I tap 'Create', Then an inline error is shown and the channel is not created
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: POST /api/channels validates name is lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens, max 32 chars
Backend: Duplicate name check returns 409 Conflict with error message
Backend: Content moderation service checks name against blocklist before creation
Web: CreateChannelSheet shows real-time validation errors as user types
Mobile: Channel creation optimistically updates UI before API confirms
stories.technical_notes: Name validation must match on both client and server to prevent UX lag

stories.title: Leave a channel
stories.i_want: leave a channel that is no longer relevant to me
stories.so_that: my channel list stays focused on active interests
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a channel I am a member of, When I tap 'Leave Channel', Then I am removed from the channel and the channel disappears from my joined list
Given I am the last member of a channel, When I leave, Then the channel is marked as inactive (not deleted) and no longer appears in public listings
Given I leave a channel, When I later browse public channels, Then that channel reappears in the public list and I can rejoin if I want
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: DELETE /api/channels/:id/leave removes membership and decrements member_count
Backend: When member_count reaches 0, set channel.status = 'inactive' (soft delete)
Backend: Inactive channels excluded from GET /api/channels unless explicitly filtered
Web: Leave action shows confirmation modal to prevent accidental exits
Mobile: Optimistically remove channel from UI and rollback if API fails
stories.technical_notes: Soft delete prevents data loss if channel was historically active

then: Channel disappears from user's joined list

given: User is the only member of channel 'niche-strategy'

features.title: Real-time Text Messaging
features.description: Users can send and receive text messages in channels with sub-second latency during market hours.

stories.title: Send a text message in a channel
stories.i_want: post a message to a channel I'm a member of
stories.so_that: I can share my thoughts and respond to others in real-time
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a channel thread, When I type a message and press Send, Then my message appears in the thread immediately and is delivered to all channel members
Given I send a message while offline, When I reconnect, Then the message is sent automatically and a delivery confirmation is shown
Given I send a message containing a ticker symbol (e.g., $TSLA), When the message is posted, Then the ticker is highlighted and clickable
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: POST /api/channels/:id/messages stores message with user_id, timestamp, content
Backend: WebSocket broadcasts message_created event to all channel members
Web: Messages use optimistic UI updates with rollback on failure
iOS: Offline messages queued locally and synced when network available
Android: FCM push notification sent to offline members with message preview
stories.technical_notes: Ticker regex: \$[A-Z]{1,5}\b — must match backend and all clients

when: User types 'Bullish on $AAPL' and taps Send
then: Other members receive message in real-time

given: User types message with multiple tickers: '$TSLA $NVDA $AAPL'

features.title: Live Ticker Card Sharing & Push Notifications
features.description: Users can embed live-updating ticker price cards directly into any message, and receive push notifications for channel activity. Phase 1 engagement layer built on the MVP messaging foundation.

stories.title: Share a live ticker card in a message
stories.i_want: attach a live ticker card to my message
stories.so_that: other channel members can see the current price and quickly trade on the idea I'm sharing
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing an instrument detail screen, When I tap 'Share to Chat' and select a channel, Then a message with an embedded ticker card is posted to that channel
Given a ticker card is posted in a channel, When members view the message, Then the card displays: ticker symbol, current price, % change, and timestamp, all updating in real-time
Given I receive a message with a ticker card, When I tap the card, Then I navigate to the instrument detail screen with a pre-filled buy order
Given market hours have ended, When a ticker card displays, Then it shows the last traded price with a 'Market Closed' indicator
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: POST /api/channels/:id/messages supports ticker_card payload with instrument_id
Backend: WebSocket broadcasts ticker price updates to all clients viewing the card
Backend: Ticker cards render in under 200ms by batching price updates (max 1 update/second)
Web: TickerCard component subscribes to price stream and updates without full message re-render
iOS: Tapping card triggers deep link to InstrumentDetailScreen with pre-filled buy order
Android: TickerCard uses ViewHolder pattern to efficiently render large message lists with cards
stories.technical_notes: Real-time price updates use same WebSocket stream as trade execution to minimize latency

stories.title: Receive push notifications for channel messages
stories.i_want: get a push notification when someone posts in a channel I follow
stories.so_that: I can stay in the conversation without keeping the app open
acceptance_criteria: Given I have joined a channel and push notifications are enabled, When a new message is posted, Then I receive a push notification within 5 seconds showing the sender name, channel, and message preview
Given I tap the push notification, When the app opens, Then I am taken directly to the relevant channel thread with the new message visible
Given I have muted a channel, When new messages are posted there, Then no push notification is sent for that channel
Given I have turned off all notifications for the app, When messages are posted, Then no push notifications are sent regardless of channel mute settings
technical_acceptance_criteria: Backend: POST /api/notifications/preferences stores per-user per-channel mute settings
Backend: Notification service fans out to APNs (iOS) and FCM (Android) within 3 seconds of message creation
Backend: Muted channels excluded from notification fan-out at query time, not client-side
iOS: APNs payload includes channel_id and message_id for deep link routing on tap
Android: FCM notification uses high-priority channel to ensure delivery in Doze mode
stories.technical_notes: Notification service must respect APNs rate limits (max 30 pushes/second per device); batch fan-out for large channels
